data.narrative:
Spiritus is a Series A climate and energy company co-founded by Charles Cadieu and Matthew Lee that has raised $41M to date. The climate and energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, though the private peer set spans multiple stages and valuations, limiting direct comparability. Notable sector participants include Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrower peer set; applying an all-sector median would obscure stage-specific signals. Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using total capital raised ($41M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $82M. This reflects the expected appreciation between Series A and the subsequent financing round.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $70M to $94M, with a median of $82M. This range incorporates uncertainty around the 2.0x multiplier, which may vary by investor appetite, company execution velocity, and sector-specific risk factors. The primary limitation is reliance on a single applicable method; a more robust triangulation would require either narrower-stage peer financials or comparable transaction data from climate and energy Series A exits. Founder track record and unit economics remain critical variables not fully captured in this quantitative framework.
